en: Vintage German New Year greeting postcard decorated with clover motifs. It features a collage of cycling photographs and printed captions about a rider, with a large greeting 'Prosit Neujahr!' in the center. The top panel shows three images of a track cyclist with captions referencing world championships in Copenhagen (1903) and London (1904) and a professional photo in Leipzig (1906). Below are sepia photos of cyclists, including a motor‑pacing scene.
